expect.description: Nighthawk Vineyards offers an upscale, dog-friendly patio dinner overlooking Green Lake in Okanagan Falls, worth planning around. Gluten-free needs are fully accommodated: the gluten-free pear and brie pizza is good, so order it and bring the dog.

set.description: Nighthawk Vineyards overlooks Green Lake in Okanagan Falls, and in season its patio serves an upscale, dog-friendly dinner (the gluten-free pear and brie pizza is good, so bring the dog). Fall wine shop hours are Saturday and Sunday, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m., until November 8. It opens again 12 to 3 p.m. on November 14 and 15 for A Very Nighthawk Christmas, then closes until spring. The restaurant is closed for the season.

expect.description: Blue Mountain Vineyard and Cellars is a reservation-only, family-owned winery overlooking the Okanagan Falls valley, specializing in cool-climate sparkling wines, chardonnays and terroir-driven pinot noirs. Tastings run Fridays and Saturdays only, so book ahead.

set.description: Blue Mountain Vineyard and Cellars is a family-owned winery overlooking the Okanagan Falls valley, specializing in cool-climate sparkling wines, chardonnays and terroir-driven pinot noirs. The tasting room is closed for tastings until spring, but you can still buy wine Monday to Friday, 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. Tastings are by reservation once it reopens.
